name: Plugnition Order Duplicator for WooCommerce
author: plugnition

sections.description:
🚀 Duplicate WooCommerce orders instantly — no setup required.

Plugnition Order Duplicator lets you clone existing orders with a single click directly from the orders list or order edit screen. Perfect for reorders, manual subscriptions, wholesale workflows, and admin efficiency.

Built with performance and simplicity in mind — just activate and start duplicating.

✨ Why you’ll love it

  • ⚡ One-click order duplication
  • 🧾 Copy products, customer, and addresses
  • 🔄 Set status for duplicated orders
  • 🧩 Advanced control over what gets copied (notes, meta, download permissions)
  • 📝 Automatic order note with reference
  • 🎯 Clean integration with WooCommerce admin
  • 🪶 Lightweight and fast (no bloat)

🧠 Perfect for:

  • Repeating customer orders
  • Wholesale & B2B workflows
  • Manual subscriptions
  • Customer support & admin tasks

🔥 Need more power? Upgrade to Pro

👉 Plugnition Order Duplicator for WooCommerce Pro

Have questions or need help getting started? We’re here to help — just reach out.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in WordPress, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to “WooCommerce > Orders”.
  4. Click “Duplicate” on any order.
  5. Optionally check the plugin settings at “WooCommerce > Settings > Order Duplicator”.
sections.faq:
Where can I duplicate orders from?

You can duplicate orders directly from the WooCommerce orders list or from the order edit screen.

What data is copied?

The plugin copies products, customer details, and billing/shipping information.

Can I change the status of the duplicated order?

Yes, you can select the desired status for the new order.

Does this work with HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I duplicate multiple orders at once?

Bulk duplication is available in the Pro version.
